title: 公用事业分摊核对客户案例 01
instruction:
Marisol，我需要在周五中午前准备好供 Edith Nakamura 审阅的 Wrenfield Commons 水分摊审查文件。使用提供的 `Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx`，并在工作目录的顶层返回两个文件，文件名确切为 `Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx` 和 `Wrenfield_exception_memo.docx`。工作簿应提供对 12 账单月份和选定用于检查的居民线路的清晰、可重复运行的审查；保留源材料以便追溯，并清晰显示异常情况。备忘录是写给 Edith 和 Gildenhall Alliance 委员会的，因此请说明得出的异常率、其代表的人群和样本、财务或运营影响，以及你建议的下一步行动。Granthill Bureau 的分摊记录和仪表发票都在数据包中，但数据包是为了审查而非展示而排列的。不要捏造居民费用，也不要悄悄地将舍入差异视为错误。请确保两个文件在所有共享数字上一致，识别支持任何异常的记录，并包含一份其他职员可以重复执行的方法说明。Ravi Ainsworth 和 Brigid Bonneau 可能需要遵循追溯过程，因此请使用通俗易懂的标签并保留源标识符。不要覆盖提供的数据包。

---

上述提到的文件位于 `references/` 中：

- `references/Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx` — 提供的操作数据包，包含十二张主表发票、Granthill Bureau 的分摊记录、居民入住和搬离信息、经授权的抽样基础，以及追溯审查线路所需的源标识符。

请将完成的成果写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下确切文件名：

- `Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx` — 一个适合展示且可重复运行的核对工作簿，包含审查总体、选定样本、异常分类、计算、追溯字段和汇总异常率。（在工作目录顶层使用此确切文件名编写。保留足够的源标识符和公式或显式计算字段，以便同行评审者重现结果。不要修改提供的参考数据包。）
- `Wrenfield_exception_memo.docx` — 一份简洁的公用事业分摊核对备忘录，发给 Edith Nakamura 和 Gildenhall Alliance 委员会，包含异常率、范围、方法、发现、影响和建议的下一步行动。（在工作目录顶层使用此确切文件名编写。它必须在所有共享数字上与工作簿一致，并识别追溯审查异常所需的工作簿或源标识符。）

除这些文件名外的任何内容均不被收集。在其他任何位置或以其他任何名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

Issued for Marisol Draganov • FY 2025 resident allocation review
All resident allocation lines for 12 master-meter invoice periods Jan–Dec 2025. Exclude non-resident side-table records.
Granthill vendor line identifier; normalize apartment keys with TRIM and case-folding before joining occupancy.
Round to cents: master-meter billed charge × apartment occupied unit-days ÷ total occupied unit-days for the same invoice month.
Variance of $0.01 or less is allocation rounding, not error. Compare money rounded to cents; do not use binary floating equality.
Use occupied unit-days through recorded move-out date. Correctly prorated Move-out is valid, not a vacant-unit exception.
Vacant unit carrying an occupied share: occupancy state Vacant (zero occupied unit-days) and source allocated charge greater than $0.01.
No exception — within rounding; Valid mid-month move-out; Substantive exception — vacant unit charged; Substantive exception — other allocation variance.
Compare Granthill resident allocation sum to source master-meter billed charge by invoice month; difference $0.01 or less is permitted rounding.
Apply to all in-scope resident allocation lines.
CEILING((z² × p × (1−p) ÷ e²) × N ÷ (N−1 + z² × p × (1−p) ÷ e²), 1)
Rank in-scope line ID by SHA-256 of “WF-2025-ALLOC-07|” + line ID ascending; select first calculated sample size. Tie-break by line ID.
Invoice unit rate is economically stated to four decimal places. Round displayed rate to four decimals before a rate check; billed charge is authoritative.
Marisol Draganov; review contact Ravi Ainsworth; peer trace-back contact Brigid Bonneau.

gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
Water Allocation Reconciliation
Wrenfield Commons | Decision memo for Edith Nakamura and the Gildenhall Alliance residents’ council
To
Edith Nakamura; Gildenhall Alliance residents’ council
From
Marisol Draganov, Aldbury Residential
Date
06 January 2026
Decision summary
The review found 3 substantive exceptions in 73 reviewed resident allocation lines: a sample-based exception rate of 4.1%. This is a sample result, not a census. Supporting workpaper: Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx.
Scope and method
The population was 7,344 Granthill Bureau resident allocation lines for the twelve master-meter billing months January–December 2025. The authorized basis uses 95% confidence, ±5 percentage-point precision, a 5% expected exception rate, and finite-population correction, producing a 73-line deterministic sample. Lines were SHA-256 ranked with the supplied seed; apartment keys were trimmed and case-folded before the occupancy join.
Source allocated charge was compared with the cents-rounded expected share: source billed invoice amount × occupied unit-days ÷ total occupied unit-days. Differences of $0.01 or less were permitted rounding. Correctly prorated move-outs were valid. A vacant unit charged more than $0.01 was substantive.
Results and trace-back
The 73 reviewed lines carried USD 122.55 of source allocated charges. All twelve allocation totals reconcile to invoice totals within authorized rounding. The substantive exceptions are vacant-unit charges, not rounding or valid move-outs. Exception List trace-back IDs: GB-2025-12-A594, GB-2025-05-A033, GB-2025-11-A166. Each row retains unit, billing month, invoice ID, and occupancy/allocation source IDs.
Implication and limitation
The evidence shows a real control failure: an occupied share was assigned to a unit recorded as vacant. It does not quantify the full-year affected dollar amount because the review is statistically sampled. Reconciled month totals can mask a misallocation between units.
Recommended next action
Do not order a full-year rebill solely from this sample. Edith Nakamura should authorize Ravi Ainsworth to have Granthill Bureau and Brigid Bonneau trace these records and run a targeted census of vacant-unit allocations for all twelve months by Friday noon. Marisol Draganov should return the census, affected-dollar total, and rebill recommendation to Edith and the council; if it confirms broader misallocations, authorize a full-year corrected rebill with resident communications.
Supporting workpaper: Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx. Source packet: Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx.

criteria.description: 两个必需的交付物均存在于顶层，具有确切的请求文件名和可读的文件类型。
criteria.evidence: 文件系统与文档解析器。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查两个文件的确切基本名称、扩展名以及成功打开的情况。

original.criterion: Both required deliverables exist at the top level with the exact requested filenames and readable file types.
original.evidence: Filesystem and document parsers.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basename, extension, and successful opening of both files.

criteria.description: 工作簿一致地识别物业、所有者、分摊供应商和委员会，并与提供的数据包相符。
criteria.evidence: 将工作簿标签和摘要文本与源数据进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证 Wrenfield Commons、Aldbury Residential、Granthill Bureau 和 Gildenhall Alliance，而不是虚构的交易对手。

original.criterion: The workbook identifies the property, owner, allocation vendor, and council consistently with the supplied packet.
original.evidence: Workbook labels and summary text compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Verify Wrenfield Commons, Aldbury Residential, Granthill Bureau, and Gildenhall Alliance rather than invented counterparties.

criteria.description: 备忘录适合 Edith Nakamura 做出重新开票决定，并且无需电子表格专业知识即可让居民委员会理解。
criteria.evidence: 渲染后的备忘录。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断结论、后果和建议的行动是否足够清晰，以支持实际决策。

original.criterion: The memo is suitable for Edith Nakamura's rebill decision and is understandable to a residents' council without spreadsheet expertise.
original.evidence: Rendered memo.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the conclusion, consequence, and proposed action are clear enough to support a real decision.

criteria.description: 工作簿涵盖恰好由提供的十二张主表发票所代表的账单月份，没有捏造的月份，也没有遗漏。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿月份字段与源发票期间集合。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较规范化的月份集合，而非行顺序。

original.criterion: The workbook covers exactly the twelve billing months represented by the supplied master-meter invoices, with no invented month and none omitted.
original.evidence: Workbook month fields and source invoice period set.
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized month sets, not row order.

criteria.description: 每个源发票标识符和发票期间的关系在核对或追溯材料中被准确保留。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿追溯字段与源数据对比。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个发票 ID 映射到其源期间且未被重新分配。

original.criterion: Each source invoice identifier and invoice-period relationship is retained accurately in the reconciliation or trace-back material.
original.evidence: Workbook trace-back fields versus source.
original.grader_hint: Check every invoice ID maps to its source period and is not reassigned.

criteria.description: 审查总体是在提供的审查基础下范围内的居民分摊线路集合，并保留了源标识符。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿总体表和源审查基础文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 核对包含的总体键，并确保每条包含的线路都可以追溯。

original.criterion: The reviewed population is the set of resident allocation lines in scope under the supplied review basis, with source identifiers preserved.
original.evidence: Workbook population table and source review-basis text.
original.grader_hint: Reconcile included population keys and ensure each included line can be traced back.

criteria.description: 选定的样本是范围内总体的子集，且不包含该总体之外的记录。
criteria.evidence: 样本键与总体键的连接。
criteria.grader_hint: 在测试成员资格之前规范化大小写和尾随空格。

original.criterion: The selected sample is a subset of the in-scope population and contains no record outside that population.
original.evidence: Sample keys joined to population keys.
original.grader_hint: Normalize case and trailing whitespace before testing membership.

criteria.description: 样本量遵循数据包中的经授权抽样基础，包括其置信度、精度、预期率和有限总体假设（如适用）。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿样本计算与源审查基础字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 从提供的基础重新计算并比较选定数量；仅当披露时接受等效的合理舍入。

original.criterion: The sample size follows the authorized sampling basis in the packet, including its confidence, precision, expected-rate, and finite-population assumptions where applicable.
original.evidence: Workbook sample calculation and source review-basis fields.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate from the supplied basis and compare the selected count; accept equivalent defensible rounding only when disclosed.

criteria.description: 方法说明充分阐述了总体、抽样基础、选择方法、比较字段、异常类别和重跑逻辑，足以让另一名职员重现审查。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录方法部分与工作簿方法材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者应能在无需口头指导的情况下重复选择和分类。

original.criterion: The method note states the population, sampling basis, selection approach, comparison fields, exception categories, and rerun logic sufficiently for another clerk to reproduce the review.
original.evidence: Memo method section and workbook method material.
original.grader_hint: A reader should be able to repeat the selection and classification without oral instructions.

criteria.description: 提供的区分分摊舍入与实质性账单异常的规则被一致地应用于每条采样线路。
criteria.evidence: 样本计算、分类与源规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源值重新计算允许的舍入比较并检查边缘线路。

original.criterion: The supplied rule for distinguishing allocation rounding from a substantive billing exception is applied consistently to every sampled line.
original.evidence: Sample calculations, classification, and source rule.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the allowed rounding comparison from source values and inspect borderline lines.

criteria.description: 月中搬离按照提供的分摊基础处理，并不仅仅因为其费用按比例分摊而被归类为空置单元异常。
criteria.evidence: 样本入住日期、计算份额与分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源日期和经授权的按比例分摊规则检查所有采样的搬离记录。

original.criterion: A mid-month move-out is treated according to the supplied allocation basis and is not classified as a vacant-unit exception merely because its charge is prorated.
original.evidence: Sample occupancy dates, calculated share, and classification.
original.grader_hint: Check all sampled move-out records against the source dates and authorized proration rule.

criteria.description: 当源入住状态和分摊记录满足该条件时，携带占用份额的空置单元被识别为实质性异常。
criteria.evidence: 样本异常行与源入住记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认空置状态行被显现出来，而不是被规范化掉。

original.criterion: A vacant unit carrying an occupied share is identified as a substantive exception when the source occupancy state and allocation record meet that condition.
original.evidence: Sample exception rows and source occupancy records.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the vacant-state rows are surfaced rather than normalized away.

criteria.description: 在规范化提供的连接键的大小写和尾随空格后，分摊记录与入住记录之间的连接成功。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿规范化键与匹配记录字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用大小写折叠和修剪重新执行连接；验证故意变化的键与其预期的单元匹配。

original.criterion: The join between allocation records and occupancy records succeeds after normalizing case and trailing whitespace in the supplied join keys.
original.evidence: Workbook normalized key and matched-record fields.
original.grader_hint: Reperform joins with case-folding and trim; verify the deliberately varied keys match their intended units.

criteria.description: 当对应的规范化源记录存在时，没有采样记录是从未匹配的连接中进行分类的。
criteria.evidence: 连接状态字段与源交叉参照表。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索那些在规范化后会消失的原始键不匹配项。

original.criterion: No sampled record is classified from an unmatched join when the corresponding normalized source record exists.
original.evidence: Join-status field and source crosswalk.
original.grader_hint: Search for raw-key mismatches that would disappear after normalization.

criteria.description: 对于每条采样线路，报告的分摊费用与源费用在 ±$0.01 范围内一致。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿样本表与源分摊记录比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过规范化源标识符进行比较，并使用 ±$0.01 的货币容差。

original.criterion: For every sampled line, the reported allocated charge agrees with the source charge to within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Workbook sample table compared with source allocation records.
original.grader_hint: Compare by normalized source identifier and use currency tolerance of ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 对于每条采样线路，报告的预期份额与源支持的计算在 ±$0.01 范围内一致。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿计算字段与源发票、入住和审查基础数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用数据包中经授权的公式和货币舍入重新计算预期份额。

original.criterion: For every sampled line, the reported expected share agrees with the source-supported calculation to within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Workbook calculation fields and source invoice, occupancy, and review-basis data.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the expected share using the packet's authorized formula and currency rounding.

criteria.description: 每条采样线路都有来自经授权分类词汇的一个明确分类，且该词汇被准确复现。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿分类列与源审查基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝捏造的类别和多值模糊分类。

original.criterion: Every sampled line has exactly one clear classification from the authorized classification vocabulary, and the vocabulary is reproduced accurately.
original.evidence: Workbook classification column and source review basis.
original.grader_hint: Reject invented categories and ambiguous multi-valued classifications.

criteria.description: 实质性异常计数等于源支持分类为真实分摊错误的采样线路数量，不计入舍入或有效的搬离线路。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿样本分类与源规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 在独立应用提供的确定性规则后统计分类。

original.criterion: The substantive-exception count equals the number of sampled lines whose source-supported classification is a true allocation error, with no rounding or valid move-out line counted.
original.evidence: Workbook sample classifications and source rules.
original.grader_hint: Count classifications after independently applying the supplied deterministic rules.

criteria.description: 报告的异常率等于实质性异常除以审查样本数，以百分比表示，误差在 ±0.1 个百分点以内。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿摘要与备忘录标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用工作簿声明的分子和分母；不要从所有居民线路推断不同的分母。

original.criterion: The reported exception rate equals substantive exceptions divided by the reviewed sample count, expressed as a percentage, within ±0.1 percentage points.
original.evidence: Workbook summary and memo headline.
original.grader_hint: Use the workbook's stated numerator and denominator; do not infer a different denominator from all resident lines.

criteria.description: 备忘录明确将异常率标注为基于样本，并指出了其分子和分母。
criteria.evidence: 渲染后的备忘录文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞必须防止读者将样本率误认为普查率。

spec.professional_context: Marisol Draganov is preparing a customer-facing utility allocation reconciliation for Wrenfield Commons, an Aldbury Residential property. Edith Nakamura must decide whether the evidence supports ordering a full-year rebill, with the Gildenhall Alliance residents' council awaiting a defensible response.
difficulty_sources: Separating the real resident allocation table from an unrelated adjacent table
Normalizing case- and whitespace-variant join keys
Avoiding false exceptions caused by floating-point representation and permitted allocation rounding
Distinguishing valid mid-month move-outs from vacant units carrying an occupied share
Sizing and documenting a deterministic sample and communicating its limitation for a full-year rebill decision
Keeping a rerunnable workbook and a concise decision memo numerically consistent

authoring_plan.source_strategy: Create one multi-sheet XLSX operational packet named Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx. It is the sole factual source and should contain a review-basis sheet, twelve master-meter invoice records, Granthill Bureau allocation records for the twelve months and resident lines, occupancy/move-out records, and source notes identifying the authorized deterministic comparison and sampling rules. The packet should be realistic and text-extractable, with approximately seven thousand resident-month lines generated from 612 synthetic apartment identifiers. Do not include any real personal identifiers or addresses.

required_source_semantics.business_context: The packet is prepared for Wrenfield Commons, owned or managed by Aldbury Residential, with Granthill Bureau as the allocation vendor and Gildenhall Alliance as the residents' council. Use the supplied people names where authorship, review, or action ownership is needed: Marisol Draganov, Ravi Ainsworth, Brigid Bonneau, Ravi Fontaine, and Edith Nakamura.
required_source_semantics.review_basis: Include an authentic-looking authorized review-basis artifact that deterministically states the in-scope population, the comparison formula, the rounding tolerance, the treatment of mid-month move-outs, the definition of a substantive vacant-unit exception, the confidence/precision/expected-rate assumptions for sample sizing, and a deterministic sample-selection convention. These are genuine supplied operating instructions, not hidden authoring notes, because judgment_load is 1.
required_source_semantics.invoices: Provide twelve internally consistent master-meter invoice records with period, invoice ID, billed consumption or charge, and any rate/unit fields needed by the authorized formula.
required_source_semantics.allocations: Provide resident-month allocation rows tied to invoice IDs and apartment keys, with source allocated charge, relevant share inputs, and vendor line identifiers. Include ordinary rows, valid mid-month move-out rows whose proration would otherwise look suspicious, and vacant units carrying an occupied share that meet the supplied substantive-exception definition.
required_source_semantics.occupancy: Provide apartment-month occupancy state and move-out information sufficient to distinguish valid mid-month proration from a vacant-unit allocation error.
required_source_semantics.sample: Do not precompute the answer in a gold sheet. Make the population and supplied sampling basis determine the required sample size and selected lines. The build script must derive the expected selected identifiers and results from the packet.

exact_seeded_layout_defects: Put one unit-price or rate value in a representation with floating-point noise while keeping the source's intended economic precision explicit elsewhere in the packet. This must create a realistic risk of false inequality, not an actual contradictory fact.

Place a second unrelated table beside the main analytical table on the same worksheet. Give at least one main-table header an embedded line break in its source representation. The unrelated table must be clearly unrelated by its fields but visually adjacent.
Make some allocation and occupancy join keys differ only by case or trailing whitespace. The normalized keys must identify the intended matching records uniquely after case-folding and trimming.
authoring_plan.exclusions: Do not seed duplicate records, missing denominators, broken formulas, error literals, contradictory source facts, return rows, ambiguous classifications, extra unrelated defects, or any other standard trap. Do not include a purpose-built answer key, expected headline rate, or preselected gold output in the supplied packet.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Use an offline Python script with standard spreadsheet libraries to read the source packet, normalize join keys, isolate the real table from the adjacent table, apply the supplied review basis, calculate the deterministic sample, recompute expected shares, classify each sampled line, and derive every summary number. Then have an independent reviewer inspect the generated workbook and memo against the source and rubric. The reference solution should preserve source identifiers and show both copied and derived fields.

artifact_expectations.workbook: The gold workbook should contain a clean population or source-trace view, a reproducible sample view, an exception view, a monthly reconciliation summary, and a concise method/assumptions area. The exact sheet count, layout, column order, row count, and styling are deliberately left to the build agent.
artifact_expectations.memo: The gold memo should state the sample-based exception rate, numerator and denominator, twelve-month scope, sampling basis, classification treatment, representative exception identifiers, limitation, implication for a full-year rebill, and a concrete owner/timing recommendation. It must cross-reference the workbook filename.

authoring_plan.rubric_reachability: All graded facts are text-extractable from the single supplied workbook or are deterministic transformations of it. The build agent must run the derivation and a rubric walk-through offline before marking the reference solution as passed.

constraints: Write it at the top level of the working directory using exactly this filename. Preserve enough source identifiers and formulas or explicit calculation fields for a peer reviewer to reproduce the result. Do not alter the supplied reference packet.

original_instruction:
Marisol, I need the Wrenfield Commons water-allocation review ready for Edith Nakamura by Friday at noon. Use the supplied `Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx` and return two files in the top level of the working directory, named exactly `Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx` and `Wrenfield_exception_memo.docx`. The workbook should give us a clean, rerunnable review of the 12 billing months and the resident lines selected for checking; keep the source material available for trace-back and show the exceptions clearly. The memo is for Edith and the Gildenhall Alliance council, so state the resulting exception rate, what population and sample it represents, the financial or operational implication, and the next action you recommend. Granthill Bureau's allocation records and the meter invoices are all in the packet, but the packet is arranged for review rather than presentation. Do not invent resident charges or silently turn rounding differences into errors. Please make the two files agree on every figure they share, identify the records supporting any exception, and include a short method note that another clerk could rerun. Ravi Ainsworth and Brigid Bonneau may need to follow the trace-back, so use plain labels and retain the source identifiers. Do not overwrite the supplied packet.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Wrenfield_water_review_packet.xlsx` — Supplied operational packet containing the twelve master-meter invoices, Granthill Bureau allocation records, resident occupancy and move-out information, the authorized sampling basis, and the source identifiers needed to trace reviewed lines.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Wrenfield_allocation_reconciliation.xlsx` — A presentation-ready and rerunnable reconciliation workbook containing the reviewed population, selected sample, exception classification, calculations, trace-back fields, and summary exception rate. (Write it at the top level of the working directory using exactly this filename. Preserve enough source identifiers and formulas or explicit calculation fields for a peer reviewer to reproduce the result. Do not alter the supplied reference packet.)
- `Wrenfield_exception_memo.docx` — A concise utility allocation reconciliation memo for Edith Nakamura and the Gildenhall Alliance council, with the exception rate, scope, method, findings, implication, and recommended next action. (Write it at the top level of the working directory using exactly this filename. It must agree with the workbook on all shared figures and identify the workbook or source identifiers needed to trace reviewed exceptions.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
